nonFunctional.statement: The planner shall give a planning decision within 3000 ms for 95 percent of requests.
nonFunctional.metric: 95th percentile of the time from request to decision
nonFunctional.measure: measure-apis.js times the three outside calls; the slowest p95 plus 500 ms of our own work must fit.

nonFunctional.statement: When an outside API is down, the planner shall still answer, and the decision shall be needs-review.
nonFunctional.metric: share of planning requests answered while one outside API is down
nonFunctional.measure: An integration test makes each outside API fail in turn and checks for a needs-review answer.

nonFunctional.statement: The planner shall retry a failed outside call up to 3 times before it gives up.
nonFunctional.metric: attempts made for one failing outside call
nonFunctional.measure: A unit test with a fake fetch that always fails counts the attempts.

nonFunctional.statement: The repository shall hold no secrets or API keys, and the planner shall validate all input.
nonFunctional.metric: secrets found in the repository, plus inputs accepted without validation
nonFunctional.measure: A test scans the source files for key patterns; each endpoint test sends one bad input and expects 400.

nonFunctional.statement: The planner shall give the organizer every reason for a decision in plain language.
nonFunctional.metric: share of decisions whose reasons are full sentences without codes
nonFunctional.measure: A test reads the reasons of the seven seed requests and rejects codes such as BR-03.

nonFunctional.statement: The planner shall exchange JSON over HTTP, write dates in ISO 8601, and write currencies as ISO 4217 codes.
nonFunctional.metric: share of responses that follow all three conventions
nonFunctional.measure: A contract test checks the content type, the date format, and the currency code of each response.

nonFunctional.statement: Every endpoint of the planner shall have at least one automated test.
nonFunctional.metric: share of endpoints with an automated test
nonFunctional.measure: verify.js lists the endpoints of the OpenAPI file and looks for a tagged test of each.

nonFunctional.statement: The planner shall handle 20 planning requests per minute without errors.
nonFunctional.metric: planning requests handled per minute without an error
nonFunctional.measure: A load test sends 20 requests in one minute to a planner with fake outside services.
